scope: Primary motor specification used for a separate bounded native normal-voltage family; approximate actuator choice, not a part list.
sourceInspection: Parent actuator reviewer and this electrical-study worker visually inspected the primary one-page drawing. All table values are specified at25degC; inductance is measured at1000Hz.
curveLimit: Drawing shows continuous force falling toward about52N at one travel end. The native real_coil family uses constant24.4N/A and25mm conservative travel; it does not qualify the force-vs-position curve or temperature-dependentKf.
physicalIntegration: Motor does not provide its own mechanical guidance; external bearing/flexure/slide is required. B0.6kg can include0.240kg moving coil plus holder; A1.5kg can include1.24kg motor body plus mount, while S2kg remains tool-side.
hotWindingScope: Rfactor1.39 represents an assumed100degC copper-winding temperature rise using a0.0039/degC coefficient. This is a hypothetical identified operating condition with inner resistance compensation updated, not a thermal model, safe-temperature qualification or manufacturer hot-force guarantee. Supplier continuous-force/power ratings have distinct stated conditions; force-vs-position remains unqualified.

derivedHorizontalHold.formula: Ihold=50/Kf; windingV=Ihold*R; coilHeat=Ihold^2*R; linearDriverHeat=Ihold*(Vbus-windingV), zero back EMF/electronics power excluded. Analytical calculation.

amplifierHeadroomScope: TA115 up to+/-43V motor voltage on48V supply suggests a possible several-volt drop but does not guarantee24V performance. Study records requested-voltage margin against19/20V effective24V output and conditionally runs atmost4 native real-coil hotcases with those terminal caps. These are explicit conservative envelopes.
qualificationLimit: Native averaged current-loop response and voltage clipping can be tested with these values. Mechanical guidance, actuator force map, winding cooling, actual amplifier voltage/current/noise/command delay and real contact mechanics still need measurements.
